thesisQuality.note: Record backlog, broad infrastructure demand and Superior capability support durable demand/value capture, tempered by contestable construction economics and execution risk.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Revenue +23.4%, adjusted EBITDA +39.8%, margin expansion, backlog +30% and raised guidance support strong momentum; negative $59M quarterly FCF prevents a higher score.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: Current market data around $16.8B market cap, ~33.8x trailing P/E and ~19.5x forward P/E is not conventionally cheap but offers plausible growth-adjusted headroom.

catalystScore.note: Raised full-year guidance, record backlog conversion and Superior/data-center integration provide multiple identifiable near-term operating catalysts.

governancePower.note: Management raised guidance amid strong execution, but Superior integration, purchase-price and financing risks cap the assessment.

alignment2036.note: Power delivery, communications, clean-energy and data-center electrical infrastructure directly serve durable grid, connectivity and compute needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Multiple infrastructure segments plus Superior reuse skilled execution capabilities across power, communications, energy and data-center markets.

bottleneckControl.note: Scale, skilled labor, safety systems and customer relationships provide meaningful constraint participation, but services remain competitively contestable.

scenarioRobustness.note: Diversified infrastructure segments provide multiple demand paths, offset by shared sensitivity to capital budgets, rates, permitting and project timing.

substitutionResilience.note: Execution scale and customer qualification create moderate replacement friction, but alternative contractors remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.note: Scale provides procurement and labor-management capacity, but skilled labor, equipment/material availability and project logistics remain meaningful dependencies.

pricingPower.note: Margin expansion demonstrates some value capture, while competitive bidding, project mix and labor/input costs limit durable pricing power.

risk.note: Strong backlog and earnings coexist with negative quarterly FCF, acquisition integration, project execution, working-capital and infrastructure-cycle risks.

confidence.note: Recent issuer results and filing provide strong operating evidence and current independent market data supports valuation; exact data-center backlog contribution and post-close Superior economics remain unquantified.

thesis: MasTec combines record infrastructure backlog, accelerating earnings and expanding power/data-center capability, with cash conversion and acquisition execution as principal constraints.
keyRisk: Backlog growth may fail to convert into durable free cash flow if project mix, labor, working capital or Superior integration deteriorate.
nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 earnings and evidence of backlog conversion, cash-flow normalization and Superior integration.
